hard_gates: Preserve ports, parameter defaults, reset behavior and observable cycle behavior.
Use the fixed provided testbench, tools, device and constraints without modification.
Static/interface checks, compile, simulation and real routed metric integrity must pass.
Timing closure requires setup slack >= 0 and hold slack >= 0.
Unknown or absent evidence cannot count as success.

implementation.meaning: Out-of-context implementation (chip_top_flow_for_soc_block): the top is a block inside a larger design, synthesized with synth_design -mode out_of_context and placed and routed without I/O buffers or package pins. clk is constrained at the target period and modeled as driven by a global clock buffer (HD.CLK_SRC). Data ports have no input or output delay and no pad delay, so they are unconstrained I/O; the routed WNS and WHS, and timing acceptance, cover the internal clocked paths only, and combinational logic between a port and its first or last register is not timed. Utilization excludes I/O buffers.

metric_provenance: Structured metrics are parsed from retained reports; routed utilization/timing reports take precedence when present. The manifest identifies complete files by hash. Header excerpts are bounded previews, not complete reports or an independent metric source.
objective_policy: First establish timing feasibility. A verified timing-feasible candidate may replace a known timing-infeasible previous best even with higher area or power; classify this as timing_recovery, not objective savings. While the previous best is timing-infeasible, a verified still-infeasible candidate with strictly better setup WNS and hold not worse beyond a small tolerance may replace it as timing_progress, which is not closure; a feasible candidate always outranks it. Once both are timing-feasible, require strict improvement of the chosen objective; for maximize_freq that is register-to-register setup slack (reg2reg_wns_ns) when both designs report it, otherwise full setup WNS for both, while feasibility stays on full WNS and WHS. minimize_luts compares (lut_used, ff_used) and minimize_ffs compares (ff_used, lut_used) lexicographically: an equal primary metric with a strictly lower secondary is an objective improvement, a higher primary never is, and a secondary missing from either design gives no tie-break. Unknown or contradictory incumbent timing evidence cannot establish recovery. A completed experiment may find no improvement. Do not invent mandatory savings, slack margins, tool versions, timing corners, new tests, thresholds, code-style quotas or external environment requirements.
